_note: Single source of truth for the CITYHOOD economy. Numbers are pushed on-chain by contracts/scripts/deploy.ts (and configure.ts) and mirrored in the frontend + backend by `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs`. Costs are whole $CITY, times are seconds (0 = instant, no builder needed), rate is $CITY per hour at level 1, boost is basis points (100 = +1%) at level 1.
